string.text: Log:\nTest. Test. He hears. Test over.
Log:\nMonolith, hear us. We are coming to you.
Log:\nWhat was my name... I remember a dog. Ginger. I don't remember the name. Hers either.
Incoming:\nPost at the Radar. Unbelievers coming from the south. He sees them. Meet them.
Log:\nHe spoke today. Not in words. Like warmth at the back of the head. Brother Taras wept. So did I.
Log:\nShopp... list: bread, batter.. AA, call Le
Log:\nThe strangers seek Him for riches. Fools. He does not grant riches. He grants peace.
Incoming:\nAll brothers. Whoever comes back from beyond the ring without an order is no brother. Treat him as a stranger.
Log:\nDreamt of Pripyat last night. Alive. People, a trolleybus. Woke up afraid. Prayed - it passed.
Log:\nMonolith. Monolith. Monolith. Monolith. Monolith.
Log:\nBrother Vasyl ran out of ammo. He walked at them unarmed. He was not afraid. I want to be like that.
Log:\nCold. Third day without wanting to eat. That is good. It means closer.
Log:\nCoordinates deleted. Coordinates deleted. Coordinates dele
Incoming:\nBrother, are you at your post?
Outgoing:\nAt my post. He is near.
Incoming:\nStalkers at the bridge. Three. One wounded.
Outgoing:\nLet them come. The Monolith will take them all.
Log:\nIf you find this - go no further. No. Go. Go to Him. I don't know what I wanted to write.
Incoming:\nBrother, don't sleep. He doesn't like it when we sleep on watch.
Outgoing:\nI'm not sleeping. I'm listening.
Incoming:\nWhat do you hear?
Outgoing:\nA song. I think my mother sang it. Or He did.
Incoming:\nHe did. Always He.
Log:\nFound a photo in my pocket. A woman and a boy. Looked at it a long time. Then burned it. That is right.
Incoming:\nAll brothers. The northern road is closed. The Scorcher sings. Listen and be calm.
Log:\n5.45 - two mags. No grenades. Water - one flask. Prayer - always.
Incoming:\nBrother Ostap, the new one is asking about home again.
Outgoing:\nLet him ask. He still remembers.
Incoming:\nHe cries at night.
Outgoing:\nWe all cried. Take him to the stone. The Monolith will take the memory. And the pain.
Log:\nNo need for money. Almost no need for food. No need for sleep. Only need to walk. And to stand.
Log:\nA stalker begged for mercy today. Said he had a daughter. I didn't understand the word "daughter". Thought a long time. Remembered. Too late.
Incoming:\n...oth... hear.. m...
Outgoing:\nBrother, say again.
Incoming:\n...don't... to Him... it's empty... there's noth...
Outgoing:\nSignal lost. I will pray for him.
Log:\nWrote "Monolith" on the wall by the bridge. In the morning it was still there. Same letters. Not my handwriting.
Incoming:\nHotel post. Unbelievers in the basements. Don't spare fire. He will give more.
Incoming:\nHave you seen Him?
Outgoing:\nNo. The brother-preacher has.
Incoming:\nWhat is He like?
Outgoing:\nThe preacher said - like a sun inside a stone. I believe.
Incoming:\nSo do I. But I want to see for myself.
Log:\nLost my old PDA, don't remember its password. This one is the brothers'. They gave me the password. The password is His name.
Log:\nThe dreams stopped. The voices stopped. One voice is left. Good.
Log:\nWe do not judge the stalkers. They walk to Him, as we do. Only we arrived, and they did not.
